text:
rachel_csm: FYI SoleraHealth onboarding p95 climbed to ~1.1s during daily peak (baseline ~650ms). Renewal in ~35 days. Customer worried. Proposing a short, low-risk plan: 1) 8% canary to compact-lite-int8, 2) tenant-level KV prefix caching, 3) time-window routing preference to dedicated-usw for peak hours. Agree?

tanvi_eng: Quick q: are they on hosted? what's median/90/99 seq len?

rachel_csm: Hosted. Median ~95, p90 ~320, p99 ~1200 (those big docs cause tails). Bursts when background batch jobs run every ~6m. Traces: https://redwood.app/trace/solerahealth/evt42

leo_ml: Given the distribution, compact-lite-int8 usually trims tail cost/latency but watch edge-case QA. Recommend running a 40-sample unit test with their top 20 user prompts plus 30 synthetic edge cases. Acceptable quality delta <=0.6% overall; any single prompt >2% regression flags mitigation.

cho_runtime: I can add a routing policy with gradual ramp and automatic rollback on quality faults. Also can enable tenant-level KV with LRU TTL 300s to catch repeated prefixes. Sample policy (will parameterize): ```json
{"policy_name":"solerahealth-peak-hedge","window":{"start":"18:00","end":"21:00","tz":"UTC"},"preference":["dedicated-usw-2","hosted"],"canary":{"model":"compact-lite-int8","pct":8},"auto_rollback_pct":0.6}
```

ops-bot: eval-run started by tanvi_eng (id: 8812). Estimated 30m.

tanvi_eng: Running eval now with token-latency histogram + 50 golden checks. I'll push a short prompt guard for the two prompts that historically flip.

ops-bot: eval-run complete (id: 8812). Results uploaded: https://redwood.app/evals/8812

tanvi_eng: Short summary: compact-lite-int8 @8% -> canary p95 = 920ms vs baseline 1100ms; overall quality delta +0.35% (within 0.6%). Two user prompts had minor truncation; applied a targeted post-processing guard for them. No infra flags.

rachel_csm: Great. I'll schedule the canary start Fri 09:30 PT and draft the customer note explaining expected improvements and the rollback plan. @amy_account can you confirm timing with SoleraHealth ops and add note to renewal playbook?

amy_account: On it. I'll confirm the window and cc legal for the change log.

cho_runtime: I'll stage the routing policy and KV toggle as a staged rollout (step 1: config push, step 2: 8% canary ramp). Monitoring alarms: p95, quality regression, error-rate. Auto-rollback enabled.

rachel_csm: Thanks team. Will capture customer feedback during the canary and post results here. :sparkles:
